主要内容: On March 13, 2018, Taxi Medallion Loan Trust III, an indirect wholly-owned subsidiary of Medallion Financial Corp., entered into an amendment to its Amended and Restated Loan and Security Agreement. The amendment extended the maturity date of the credit facility to December 15, 2018 and implemented technical changes to improve the Trust's flexibility under the credit facility. The amendment is attached as Exhibit 10.1. On March 14, 2018, the Company issued a press release announcing the amendment. The information in the press release is being furnished, not filed, pursuant to Item 8.01. The amendment is also referenced in Exhibit 10.1 and incorporated by reference in the filing. The amendment is part of the Company's financial agreements and may impact its operations and financial flexibility in the industry.
